# References

## Map from GCVE BCP-02 to this book

The GCVE Working Group's [Practical Guide to Vulnerability Handling and Disclosure](https://gcve.eu/bcp/gcve-bcp-02/) (BCP-02, v2.0) is the source for the handling lifecycle. It is published under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

| BCP-02 section | Where to apply it |
| --- | --- |
| Roles and Responsibilities, Preparing for Vulnerability Handling | [Roles and handoffs](../roles/index.qmd), [Prepare your instance](../preparing-your-instance/index.qmd) |
| Receiving and Handling Vulnerability Reports | [Intake and triage](../intake-and-triage/index.qmd) |
| Investigating and Resolving Vulnerabilities, Communicating with Submitters and Users, Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure | [Investigation and coordination](../investigation-and-coordination/index.qmd) |
| Publishing Advisories, Best Practices | [Publish as a CNA](../cna-publication/index.qmd), [Publish as a GNA](../gna-publication/index.qmd), [Publish the advisory and follow up](../advisory-and-follow-up/index.qmd) |
| Appendix A, EU Cyber Resilience Act Reporting | [Decide when to disclose](../investigation-and-coordination/index.qmd#decide-when-to-disclose) and [Use exploitation evidence in CRA reporting](../kev-catalogue/index.qmd#use-exploitation-evidence-in-cra-reporting). See [BCP-02 Appendix A](https://gcve.eu/bcp/gcve-bcp-02/#what-the-cra-adds) for the reporting process. |
| Appendix B, Multi-Party Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure in Open-Source Ecosystems | [Coordinate an upstream and downstream release](../multi-party-disclosure/index.qmd) |
